messages:
Jules (People Ops): Quick q — can we transfer unused sick (up to 3 days) into the emergency leave bank at year-end for EMEA folks? Managers say performance-review blackout (Dec 20-24) prevents approvals. Policy mentions manager sign-off before cutoff but not blackout exceptions. @Sam @Priya any precedent? :thinking_face:
Sam (Payroll): We generally need approvals before payroll cutoff. What's the payroll cutoff date for year-end?
Jules (People Ops): Payroll cutoff shows 2060-01-05 but People Ops has a policy window that ends 2060-01-15. That's the mismatch causing confusion.
Priya (People Ops): We can do a one-time exception with an audit trail. Requirements: manager written approval (email OK), HRBP signoff, and CSV import. Need to confirm legal for EMEA. @Marco can you help? :memo:
Marco (HRBP): Legal is okay with a documented exception for EMEA, provided we cap transfers and keep records. Recommend caps: full-time max 3 days, part-time max 2 days. Also need a clear deadline for manager approvals.
Luca (Eng): If my manager is OOO during the blackout, can I self-request and have someone else approve? Or does it have to be the direct manager?
Jules (People Ops): It must be the direct manager or delegated manager with a clear note of delegation. For OOO cases, escalate to the manager's skip-level and cc people-ops. No employee self-approve.
hr-bot: Reminder — exception requests must include: employee full name, employee ID, number of days to transfer, manager approval (email header + body), and local country rationale if applicable. Audit log required.
Sam (Payroll): We'll accept manager emails as proof. I'll prepare an import template CSV. Format: `employee_id,name,days_to_transfer,manager_email,manager_ts`. We'll run import on 2060-01-12 if docs received by cutoff.
Priya (People Ops): I'll draft a short exception notice and an internal step-by-step for managers. Will link to internal policy doc: https://docs.redwood/people/pto-carryover (internal).
Jules (People Ops): Proposed final process (TL;DR): 1) Managers must send approval email to people-ops@redwood.com with employee ID and days by 2060-01-10. 2) HRBP confirms eligibility. 3) Payroll runs import 2060-01-12. Caps: FT=3 days, PT=2 days, only for EMEA this cycle. Any exceptions beyond cap require exec HR sign-off.
Marco (HRBP): Confirmed. I'll sign off on EMEA cases and review any country-specific rules.
Luca (Eng): Sounds good — will ping my manager now. Thanks!
Jules (People Ops): I'll post a brief announcement in #people-ops and send managers the CSV template. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
